note: simmer_unmatched_sender_total{domain} is client-controlled. Capping it diverges from SPEC.md §9.1 and needs the spec author. Also pinned in cargo test: tests/metrics_endpoint.rs.
Outbound AUTH is always PLAIN (src/downstream/client.rs): a downstream offering only LOGIN answers 535 and Simmer defers 451 on every retry. Observed against postfix-login-only in the T2 matrix.

No lock_timeout or statement_timeout (src/db.rs sets only acquire_timeout), so a query that already holds a pool connection waits on a blocked row or table indefinitely: measured at ~27 s to answer while a lock was held for 25 s.

because: closed without a reply at transport
note: A full tmpfs ends the session with no SMTP reply. MessageBuffer::append returns the ENOSPC from the §8.1 spill write, and the DATA loop maps it to DataError::Io, which tears the session down; the read side answers 451 4.3.0 internal buffering error, the write side answers nothing. Measured: a 16 MiB tmpfs under 8 concurrent 4 MiB bodies dropped 11 of 16 clients mid-DATA, none of them with a 4xx.
